name: homestead-health
description: Family health records the household holds itself — module three on Homestead · Affairs, pinning homestead.keep. The records track (roster, immunizations, due dates, school-form export, emergency-card export, the pinned CDC/ACIP schedule) is built and adversarially audited: H-1 through H-5, 128 tests green, 0 xfailed. The 2026-08-17 extension adds a living lane (a forgetting cell for in-motion household concerns, H-8) and a reference lane (an injected reader over a pinned public-domain corpus, H-7) — both built; the extension is proposed, not yet ratified (verified_by must differ from author). No network import and no listener anywhere in the module, held by tests/test_invariants_seat.py.
author: SAFE App Store

data_streams.purpose: Household health records (roster, immunizations) stored locally through homestead.keep.record
data_streams.retention: permanent local; leaves only via purposed, ledgered export (S4)
data_streams.description: Subject roster (opaque subj-NN id -> name, L3/L4) and immunization records (subject, vaccine, dose_date, next_due, provider, lot_number, source, notes -- L2-L4 fields, classified at import). Stored through homestead.keep.record's Sidecar, reached only through the gate.

data_streams.purpose: Purposed, explicit egress of a subject's records -- the school form and the emergency card
data_streams.retention: the artifact persists in exports/ until the operator removes it; the ledger entry (reference + purpose, never content) is permanent
data_streams.description: One IntegrityLog entry and one VisibleLog EXPORTED act per export, references only, head anchor held off the log's own tree so a hand-edited entry fails verify(expected_head=...).

data_streams.purpose: In-motion household concerns that are true now and not meant to accrete into a per-person history
data_streams.retention: overwrite-in-place, only-latest -- the prior value is not retained; only its SHA-256 is appended to the ledger on replacement
data_streams.description: Cells keyed by the thing (never the subject) under the household root's living/ tree. Audited via a keep IntegrityLog living_replaced entry carrying the thing's ref and the hash of what it replaced, never the value. L5, no egress.
